evidence.quote: A gradual approach will remain appropriate as long as inflationary pressures remain muted, the economy remains short of our objectives, the neutral rate remains low, and downside risks from abroad remain
with the conditions the FOMC has set for a cessation of reinvestments of principal payments on existing securities holdings being met sooner than they otherwise would have been.
risks in the domestic economy are closer to being balanced than they have been for some time.
But risks outside our borders are still tilted to the downside.
This rate is still noticeably below 2 percent, but it is up 1/4 percentage point from a year earlier.
Overall, I am pleased to see that full employment is within reach and could prove sustainable with the right policy mix.

parsed.rationale: Brainard notes improving labor markets, domestic risks nearing balance, and a possibly faster tightening and earlier end to reinvestment if fiscal stimulus materializes. She offsets this with below-target inflation, a low neutral rate, and downside foreign risks, and keeps a gradual approach, for a roughly neutral net stance.
